summary: Verified Thursday-only restriction end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass — rejects Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat with 'Appointments are only available on Thursdays' error, accepts Thursday bookings, confirms 2026-09-24 (Thu) is accepted and a future Friday is rejected with the Thursday error. Slot limits endpoint returns Abu Dhabi=300 and Dubai=200 as required. Frontend: AppointmentForm calendar correctly disables non-Thursday days (verified via DOM — only Oct 15, 22, 29 — all under 'Th' column — are enabled in October 2026). Help text correctly reads 'Available days: Thursdays only (9:00 AM - 3:00 PM). Public holidays are not available.'

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded slot text is stale: shows 'Abu Dhabi: 150 slots available daily' and 'Dubai: 80 slots available daily' while actual backend limits are 300 and 200. Misleads users on homepage.

action_items: Update AppointmentForm.js lines 833 and 856 to reflect new slot limits (Abu Dhabi 300, Dubai 200) — currently still displays old 150 / 80 values.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend validation order in server.py (line 505-525): 24-hour cutoff is checked BEFORE weekday check. For dates <24h away that happen to be non-Thursday, the user sees the 24h message instead of the Thursday-only message. Consider swapping order so the Thursday restriction is explained first (more actionable). Not a blocker — functionally correct.
Frontend disabledMatcher correctly uses getDay(date) !== 4 for Thursday (JS Sunday=0..Saturday=6). Backend uses weekday() != 3 (Python Mon=0..Sun=6). Both correct for Thursday.
Carried over: SPECIAL_SLOT_OVERRIDES hardcoded in server.py; server.py ~856 lines (above split threshold).

success_rate.frontend: 100% calendar logic + help text; stale slot-count labels flagged
